nodes.question: What findings did Hawcroft and Milfont (2010) report from their meta-analysis regarding the NEP scale?
nodes.answer: Hawcroft and Milfont (2010) reported that the ecocentric dimension of the NEP scale positively correlates with individuals' pro-ecological behaviors.
